highlights.headline: What’s the point? Ten years after the Paris treaty, are climate talks getting anywhere?
highlights.summary: <p>Its key temperature goal has been missed but experts say the agreement is still proving a vital moral compass for progress</p><p>It was a curious way of conducting negotiations. Ahead of the 2025 climate summit, in the Amazonian port of Belém last year, the Brazilian hosts had taken off the table the issue that most had assumed would be at its heart: concrete plans from each country laying out exactly what they would be doing to cut their greenhouse gas emissions.</p>&

highlights.headline: European nations signal support for fossil fuel roadmap, says COP30 president
highlights.summary: André Corrêa do Lago told Climate Home News that it's up to other nations to decide how the fossil fuel and deforestation roadmaps are used The post European nations signal support for fossil fuel roadmap, says COP30 president appeared first on Climate Home News.

items.title: Tesla to 'wind down' production of flop Cybertruck
items.description: Elon Musk's electric pickup for the future will start to be consigned to the past next year. The Cybertruck's bulk and crude shape meant it could only pass regulatory standards in more permissive markets.
